headline: North Georgia end Flagler's perfect conference start
dek: North Georgia drew at Flagler, the only points Flagler have dropped inside the conference. Neither side has lost this season. Flagler have won three and drawn four, and all of the wins have come against conference opponents.
displaced_by: Flagler drew at home to North Georgia on 19 Sep: their conference record is no longer perfect, and the standing dek's draws figure and 'outside the conference' claim are no longer true.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: North Georgia's 21 goals are more than USC Aiken and Lander have scored between them, and nine different players have shared them.

wire.line: Flagler and North Georgia drew their meeting and remain the only sides yet to lose this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, among them Clayton State's visit to Oglethorpe and Middle Georgia State's to Columbia on 22 August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored eight of North Georgia's 21 goals from 26 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored seven of Middle Georgia State's sixteen goals from 26 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Theo Hoang has scored six of Georgia Southwestern's nine goals from ten shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ryan Rivas has conceded six times in Flagler's goal this season.

last_match.line: Neither side has lost this season; the draw is the only conference match Flagler have not won.

next_match.line: North Georgia are unbeaten but have drawn more conference matches than they have won; Georgia Southwestern have yet to win inside the conference.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
